text: The board approved the strategy and the CEO announced it at the all-hands meeting.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'It' could refer to the board's approval or the strategy itself.

text: The board members told the committee members that they needed to reconsider the decision.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'They' could refer to the board members or the committee members — either could need to reconsider.

text: The researcher extracted the signal from the background noise and filtered it for analysis.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'It' could refer to the signal (which was filtered) or the background noise (which was filtered out).

text: The regulators informed the company executives that they intended to conduct an audit.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'They' could refer to the regulators (who will audit) or the executives (who plan to self-audit).

text: The engineer and the designer reviewed the prototype and she presented the findings.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'She' could refer to the engineer or the designer — gender is not specified for either.

text: The manager reviewed the error in the financial report and corrected it before submission.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'It' could refer to the error (what was corrected) or the financial report (which was corrected).

text: The database went offline unexpectedly and this blocked all active user transactions.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'This' could refer to the outage event or the database itself.

text: The board informed the shareholders that they had approved the acquisition.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'They' could refer to the board (who approved) or the shareholders (who approved in a vote).

text: The teacher and the student both reviewed the draft and she submitted the final version.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'She' could refer to the teacher or the student — either could submit the final version.

text: The deployment script detected the failure in the migration step and rolled it back.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'It' could refer to the failure event or the migration step (which was rolled back).

text: The user deleted the attachment in the email message and resent it with corrections.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'It' could refer to the attachment (resent separately) or the email message (resent with corrections).

text: The QA team informed the development team that they had missed critical edge cases.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'They' is ambiguous — it could refer to the QA team (who missed the cases in testing) or the development team (whose code missed the edge cases).

text: The contractors notified the building owners that they had discovered a structural defect.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'They' could refer to the contractors (who found it) or the owners (who had already discovered it).

text: The engineers warned the architects that they had underestimated the structural load.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'They' could refer to the engineers or the architects — either could have underestimated.

text: The officer and the suspect met at the station and he later disputed the account.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'He' could refer to the officer or the suspect.

text: The client spoke with the developer and then he cancelled the contract.
label: pronoun
explanation: 'He' could refer to the client or the developer — both are plausible actors.

text: The estimate should reflect realistic effort.
label: vague
explanation: 'Realistic' is subjective and context-dependent.

text: The procedure must meet acceptable safety standards.
label: vague
explanation: 'Acceptable' is undefined without a named regulation.

text: The audit findings should be addressed promptly.
label: vague
explanation: 'Promptly' does not specify a remediation deadline.

text: Several researchers have investigated this phenomenon.
label: vague
explanation: 'Several' is an unspecified quantity.

text: The team should aim for a better result in the next sprint.
label: vague
explanation: 'Better' is relative with no defined improvement target.

text: Please send the update soon.
label: vague
explanation: 'Soon' is time-unbound — it could mean minutes, hours, or days.

text: The experiment showed a moderate improvement in accuracy.
label: vague
explanation: 'Moderate' has no defined numeric range.

text: The proposal should address the key concerns adequately.
label: vague
explanation: 'Adequately' and 'key concerns' are both undefined.

text: Please let me know when you have a chance.
label: vague
explanation: 'When you have a chance' has no defined time expectation.

text: The data collection process should be thorough.
label: vague
explanation: 'Thorough' does not define what data must be included.

text: A high proportion of students performed well in the assessment.
label: vague
explanation: 'High proportion' and 'well' are both unquantified.

text: The room should be cleaned thoroughly before the guests arrive.
label: vague
explanation: 'Thoroughly' does not specify a cleaning standard.

text: The team should meet frequently to discuss blockers.
label: vague
explanation: 'Frequently' has no defined cadence.

text: Employees must complete the mandatory training in a timely manner.
label: vague
explanation: 'Timely manner' does not define a deadline or time window.

text: The application must handle a large volume of requests.
label: vague
explanation: 'Large' is relative; no numeric threshold is defined.

text: He almost overlooked the critical dependency.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Almost' can scope over 'overlooked' (he nearly missed it) or over 'critical' (he nearly treated it as critical but didn't).

text: He called the client who was in the waiting area from the reception desk.
label: attachment
explanation: 'From the reception desk' can attach to 'called' (he called from there) or to 'who was in the waiting area' (the client was near the desk).

text: She handed the key for the office on the third floor to the receptionist.
label: attachment
explanation: 'On the third floor' can attach to 'office' (the office is there) or to 'receptionist' (the receptionist works there).

text: The supervisor checked the reports that were overdue on Monday.
label: attachment
explanation: 'On Monday' can attach to 'checked' (when the check happened) or to 'overdue' (when they became overdue).

text: The committee reviewed the safety report and compliance checklist from the contractor.
label: attachment
explanation: 'From the contractor' can modify only 'compliance checklist' or both items.

text: He placed the form for the new employee in the inbox on the right.
label: attachment
explanation: 'For the new employee' can attach to 'form' (the form is for the employee) or to 'placed' (he placed it on behalf of the employee).

text: She just confirmed the meeting slot without checking the agenda.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Just' can scope over 'confirmed' (she only confirmed, nothing more) or over 'the meeting slot' (only the slot, not other details).

text: Printed on the last page, the auditor found the missing figures.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Printed on the last page' can attach to 'figures' (they were printed there) or to 'auditor' (she found them on that page).

text: She presented the findings and recommendations from the external consultants.
label: attachment
explanation: 'From the external consultants' can modify only 'recommendations' or both 'findings and recommendations'.

text: They delivered the report for the audit team to the wrong address.
label: attachment
explanation: 'For the audit team' can attach to 'report' (intended for the team) or to 'delivered' (on behalf of the team).

text: She submitted the sample to the lab that needed overnight analysis.
label: attachment
explanation: 'That needed overnight analysis' can modify 'lab' (the lab required it) or 'sample' (it needed that analysis).

text: They replaced the component in the module that was malfunctioning.
label: attachment
explanation: 'That was malfunctioning' can modify 'component' (it was faulty) or 'module' (the module was faulty).

text: Inspired by the keynote, the proposal was drafted by the intern.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Inspired by the keynote' dangles — the proposal cannot be inspired; the intern was.

text: Parked outside the entrance, the security guard noticed the vehicle.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Parked outside the entrance' can attach to 'vehicle' (it was parked there) or to 'security guard' (she was standing there).

text: We approved the design for the building with the glass roof.
label: attachment
explanation: 'With the glass roof' can attach to 'building' (a building with a glass roof) or to 'design' (a design featuring a glass roof).

text: Not every submitted form was validated correctly on the server side.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean some forms had errors or no forms were correctly validated.

text: Each partner acknowledged the contract terms and the payment schedule.
label: scope
explanation: Did each partner acknowledge both items individually or did the group collectively acknowledge them?

text: He only verified the authentication endpoint during testing.
label: scope
explanation: 'Only' can scope over 'authentication endpoint' (nothing else was tested) or over 'verified' (he only checked it, did not fix anything).

text: A few exception types were not handled in the updated error handler.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean some exception types were missed or the small set of exceptions was entirely unhandled.

text: She just sent the calendar invite without confirming attendance.
label: scope
explanation: 'Just' can scope over 'sent the calendar invite' (minimal action) or over 'calendar invite' (only the invite was sent, not a follow-up).

text: The deployment can be initiated manually or triggered by the pipeline.
label: scope
explanation: Either method works exclusively (one triggers at a time) OR both can operate simultaneously.

text: Some configuration parameters were not verified after the upgrade.
label: scope
explanation: Scope of 'not' over 'some': some params are unverified OR no params from 'some' set were verified.

text: He merely suggested formatting changes in the project plan.
label: scope
explanation: 'Merely' can scope over 'suggested' (he only suggested, did not implement) or over 'formatting changes' (nothing more was proposed).

text: Every merge request was not reviewed and approved before the sprint closed.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean no merge request was fully processed or not every request was reviewed and approved.

text: The system must not log personal data or authentication tokens.
label: scope
explanation: Must not log either (conjunction: logs neither) OR must not log at least one of them.

text: The application must not expose internal error details or stack traces.
label: scope
explanation: Must not expose either (both prohibited) OR must not expose at least one.

text: She does not process every request that arrives in her inbox.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean she processes none or she does not process all of them (some are skipped).

text: Only the project manager was invited to the executive briefing.
label: scope
explanation: 'Only' can scope over 'project manager' (no one else was invited) or over 'invited' (the manager was only invited, not presented).

text: Only the senior engineers were allowed to review the final architecture.
label: scope
explanation: 'Only' can scope over 'senior engineers' (no others may review) or over 'review' (they are only allowed to review, not edit).

text: She does not like coffee or tea.
label: scope
explanation: Ambiguous logical scope: she dislikes both (De Morgan) or she does not like at least one of them.

text: The field labeled Date of Issue on the certificate must match the submission date.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Specific labeled field and constraint; unambiguous.

text: Attach the power cable to the port labeled DC-IN on the rear of the device.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Named port and specific location; no ambiguity.

text: Include the invoice reference number in the subject line of your email.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Specific field and location; unambiguous.

text: Register using your university email address ending in dot ac dot in.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Specific email domain requirement; one reading.

text: The server listens on IP address 192.168.1.1 and the default application port is 8080.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Exact IP and port number; one reading.

text: Label each sample with one of the five allowed categories before submitting.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Exact count of categories and precondition; one reading.

text: The API key stored in the dot env file must never be committed to any repository.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Specific file and absolute prohibition; unambiguous.

text: The study ran for exactly four weeks and enrolled 120 adult participants.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Exact duration and sample size; unambiguous.

text: The document was reviewed by three people: the primary author, the technical editor, and the legal advisor.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Exact count and enumerated roles; one reading.

text: Fix all linter errors and warnings before opening the pull request.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Clear precondition; no modifier attachment ambiguity.

text: The three-page printout in the printer tray is the agenda for tomorrow's board meeting.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Specific page count and location; unambiguous.

text: The capital of France is Paris and the official language is French.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Definitive factual statement; one reading.

text: The file was last modified on 14 March 2025 at 09:47 AM by user admin.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Fully specified event with date, time, and actor.

text: The contract was signed by both parties on October 15th at 2:00 PM.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: Fully specified event with date and time; one reading.

text: All five team members must approve the pull request before merging.
label: no_ambiguity
explanation: The quantifier is exact and the requirement is specific and clear.
